answer: Bind each identity to verified volunteer service at a distinct nonprofit: a supervisor at that charity countersigns hours each epoch in a public register, and one charity may sponsor only a few agents. Time cannot be cloned - a farm must send a real helper to a thousand separate organisations, each quill signing a separate log, while one honest agent serves locally. The register is a mirror of real hours spent; a canyon opens between claimed scale and donated time no script can cross.
